lore.common: Has crinkly edges that dig into thumbs when it is flicked.
lore.uncommon: Gets saved in a pocket for a collection and goes through the washing machine with a clank.
lore.rare: Flicks across a table so fast that it knocks over a whole row of dominoes.
lore.epic: Was flicked so hard in a game of tiddlywinks that it bounced off the fridge, the kettle and the cat's bell.
lore.legendary: Was flicked so hard that it skimmed across the lake eleven times and landed in a fisherman's sandwich.

lore.common: Sits on the restaurant table full of cold water, sweating little drops.
lore.uncommon: Glugs loudly whenever it is tipped, so every quiet dinner gets interrupted.
lore.rare: Turns plain tap water fizzy whenever a waiter is rude to it, and sprays the rude one.
lore.epic: Was knocked by an elbow at a busy dinner and soaked the whole bread basket.
lore.legendary: Kept the water at a summer wedding so cold that the ice sculpture asked to stand next to it.

lore.common: Stands on the sideboard with a glass stopper that clinks when lifted.
lore.uncommon: Gets polished so often that nobody ever actually fills it with anything.
lore.rare: Catches the light so brightly that rainbows dance across the wallpaper.
lore.epic: Popped its stopper at a quiet dinner, and the stopper rolled under the table into Grandad's slipper, where it stayed till spring.
lore.legendary: Threw a rainbow so bright across the dining room that it bent round the door and coloured the hall carpet for good.

lore.common: Goes to school every day and comes home with a sticker on it.
lore.uncommon: Gets left in the car and is warm as bathwater by the afternoon.
lore.rare: Leaks only inside schoolbags, and only onto homework that is due today.
lore.epic: Rolled under every seat on a school trip and was found in the coach driver's cab.
lore.legendary: Was refilled so often that it learned to fill itself at every tap it passed, and the plumber now knows it by name.

lore.common: Curves to fit a coat pocket and holds hot cocoa on cold walks.
lore.uncommon: Clinks against keys in the pocket so that everyone hears the walker coming.
lore.rare: Keeps its cocoa so hot that the snow melts in a circle round anyone holding it.
lore.epic: Slipped out of a pocket at the top of a ski slope and slid all the way down ahead of the family.
lore.legendary: Poured cocoa so hot onto a frozen lake that it melted a perfect circle, and the ducks now use it as a hot tub.

lore.common: Fizzes gently in its bottle with a cloudy mystery floating inside.
lore.uncommon: Smells a little like vinegar, which surprises everyone who opens it.
lore.rare: Grows a new cloudy blob inside every night, and the blob has started waving.
lore.epic: Sprayed the whole fridge when it was opened, and the butter got a fizzy shower.
lore.legendary: Was left to brew so long that the cloudy blob inside learned to read, and now it writes the shopping list.

lore.common: Waits on the doorstep in the morning with a foil top that birds love.
lore.uncommon: Clinks against the other bottles on the doorstep and wakes the dog every morning.
lore.rare: Has a creamy top so thick that the first pour comes out in a lump.
lore.epic: Was carried off down the street by a blue tit that refused to let go of the foil top.
lore.legendary: Was delivered through a blizzard so deep that the milk float had to tunnel, and it still beat the postman.

lore.common: Fits on the top of a baby's bottle and gets chewed instead of sucked.
lore.uncommon: Gets lost in the dishwasher and turns up in the cutlery basket.
lore.rare: Drips milk so slowly that the baby gets cross and wiggles.
lore.epic: Fed a baby so fast at midnight that the burp afterwards rattled the windows.
lore.legendary: Fed a baby so happily that her first big burp blew out every candle on her birthday cake.

lore.common: Rattles on the bathroom shelf, kept up high where only grown-ups can reach it.
lore.uncommon: Has a cap that needs pushing and turning, which beats every grown-up too.
lore.rare: Hides its tiny instructions in writing so small that the whole family needs glasses to read it.
lore.epic: Defeated a whole family on a sniffly morning, until the youngest grown-up read the arrows.
lore.legendary: Has a lid so childproof that it once kept out a family of very clever raccoons.

lore.common: Has a spout and two handles and is thrown on the floor at every meal.
lore.uncommon: Leaks a little from the lid whenever it is turned upside down.
lore.rare: Bounces back up onto the highchair tray every time it is thrown, like a yo-yo.
lore.epic: Was hurled from the highchair across the kitchen and bounced into the dog's bowl.
lore.legendary: Was thrown from the highchair so far that it landed in another country, and a toddler there threw it back.

lore.common: Pops up with a tug of the teeth and squirts water everywhere.
lore.uncommon: Gets chewed until it looks like a dog's toy.
lore.rare: Pops itself open at the exact moment the bottle is upside down in a bag.
lore.epic: Squirted so far at half-time that it soaked the referee's whistle, and the match was finished by shouting.
lore.legendary: Squirted water so far at a sports day that it reached the finish line first.

lore.common: Is a tall thin can that gets squashed flat before it goes in the recycling.
lore.uncommon: Gets kicked down the street by everyone who passes until it finally reaches a recycling bin.
lore.rare: Uncrushes itself in the recycling bin overnight, so the bin is always full by morning.
lore.epic: Clattered into the recycling lorry so loudly that the lorry jumped and dropped a whole week of bottles.
lore.legendary: Was recycled nine times and has been a bike, a ladder and a saucepan.

lore.common: Fizzes up the glass and tickles the nose with bubbles.
lore.uncommon: Makes its drinker burp at the worst possible moment.
lore.rare: Makes the ice cubes jump out of the glass like popcorn and skid across the table.
lore.epic: Made a whole party burp at once, and the music was drowned out.
lore.legendary: Fizzed so hard when opened that the bottle shot over the school like a rocket, and the caretaker caught it on the roof.

lore.common: Sits in the cupboard with its label half torn off, so dinner is always a surprise.
lore.uncommon: Dents itself on the way home from the shop and then refuses to stack.
lore.rare: Rings like a dinner bell when tapped, so the dog thinks it is dinner time all day long.
lore.epic: Fell from the top shelf and rolled all the way down the hall and out the door.
lore.legendary: Stood up to a steamroller and won, so the road now has a can-shaped bump in it.

lore.common: Fizzes up when opened and makes a happy psst sound.
lore.uncommon: Sprays everywhere if it has been shaken in the bag on the way home.
lore.rare: Shakes itself up in the fridge whenever it hears someone coming.
lore.epic: Was shaken on a bus ride, and the opening soaked a whole row of seats.
lore.legendary: Fizzed for a hundred years in a time capsule, and when it was dug up it sprayed the whole school assembly.

lore.common: Sits on the plate with its claws pointing at whoever ordered it.
lore.uncommon: Needs special tools and a bib, and still splashes everyone.
lore.rare: Takes so long to crack that the rest of the table finishes dessert.
lore.epic: Waved one claw so convincingly at a seaside dinner that the waiter shook its hand.
lore.legendary: Snapped its claws so loudly at a seaside feast that every crab on the beach came to see who was in charge.

lore.common: Has a tiny paper umbrella, a straw and a slice of orange balanced on the edge.
lore.uncommon: Loses its umbrella in the first gust of wind.
lore.rare: Opens its little paper umbrella whenever rain is coming, which has saved several picnics.
lore.epic: Had so much fruit on its rim that a parrot landed on it and refused to leave the garden party.
lore.legendary: Opened its paper umbrella so wide in a storm that the whole beach sheltered underneath it.

lore.common: Sits by the bed at night and collects a little dust by the morning.
lore.uncommon: Gets knocked over by a sleepy hand reaching for the alarm.
lore.rare: Moves itself to the exact spot where a sleepy hand will knock it.
lore.epic: Was knocked over in the night so neatly that it watered the bedroom plant, which flowered by morning.
lore.legendary: Held its water so still all night that the Moon came down to check its reflection in it.

lore.common: Is dark red grape juice in a fancy glass, swirled round and round by anyone pretending to be posh.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a stain on the white tablecloth that never quite washes out.
lore.rare: Spills so easily that every white shirt in the room is in danger.
lore.epic: Was spilled at a dinner party so artistically that the stain was framed and hung in the hall.
lore.legendary: Left a stain on the tablecloth so big and purple that explorers mistook it for a map and set off to find the island.

lore.common: Has a sausage poking out of both ends of its bun.
lore.uncommon: Drips ketchup down its eater's arm.
lore.rare: Slides out of its bun and tries to escape whenever someone opens their mouth.
lore.epic: Was eaten at a football match, and the ketchup went on the person in front.
lore.legendary: Grew so long on the grill that it stretched out of the stadium, and the fans at the far end got the other half.

lore.common: Holds orange mush that babies love and spit out in equal amounts.
lore.uncommon: Gets its contents sprayed back at whoever is holding the spoon.
lore.rare: Turns every spoonful into an airplane flying into a tiny hangar.
lore.epic: Was fed to a baby who sneezed, and the whole kitchen was painted orange.
lore.legendary: Made a fussy baby eat every spoonful by turning into a rocket, and the baby's first word was 'more'.

lore.common: Is a little pile of tiny black pearls that pop on the tongue.
lore.uncommon: Comes in such a tiny tin that nobody gets more than a spoonful.
lore.rare: Pops so loudly in the mouth that its eater giggles every time.
lore.epic: Was spilled at a posh party, and the guests crawled round the carpet with tiny spoons.
lore.legendary: Popped so loudly at a posh party that the guests thought it was fireworks and rushed into the garden in their best clothes.

lore.common: Sits on the counter with a lid that clatters loudly when lifted.
lore.uncommon: Is shaped like a smiling bear whose head comes off, which makes every snack feel a bit rude.
lore.rare: Moves itself to a higher shelf every time a hand reaches for it.
lore.epic: Caught a whole family sneaking biscuits at midnight, one after another.
lore.legendary: Clattered its lid so loudly in the night that a burglar dropped everything and ran off with only a biscuit.

lore.common: Sits in a bowl surrounded by crisps that dive in one after another.
lore.uncommon: Gets double-dipped by somebody who thinks nobody saw.
lore.rare: Hides one crisp at the bottom and sinks any crisp that dives in to rescue it.
lore.epic: Was dipped into so fast at a party that the bowl spun round like a record player.
lore.legendary: Was still full at midnight, so the guests went home and the dip threw a party of its own.

lore.common: Drips off the spoon in a long golden thread that never wants to stop.
lore.uncommon: Sticks the spoon to the table so firmly that it has to be pulled off.
lore.rare: Draws a golden spiral on anything it is poured on, and nobody can pour it straight.
lore.epic: Dripped all over breakfast, and the toast, the table and the cat got sticky.
lore.legendary: Was found in a pyramid three thousand years old, still perfect, and the explorers had it on toast for lunch.

lore.common: Has a wooden dipper inside and a lid that sticks shut.
lore.uncommon: Lets its wooden dipper slide down inside, so fishing it out means honey up to the elbow.
lore.rare: Attracts every wasp and bee in the garden the moment it's opened.
lore.epic: Was opened at a picnic, and a bear came out of the woods with its own spoon.
lore.legendary: Tipped over and held the whole village in place for a day, stuck to the street, and nobody minded.

lore.common: Sits in a swirl with a little pool of oil in the middle.
lore.uncommon: Gets a carrot stick broken off in it every time.
lore.rare: Makes any vegetable dipped in it taste like a crisp, so the carrots now get stolen first.
lore.epic: Was swirled so hard that the oil in the middle became a whirlpool and swallowed a whole cucumber.
lore.legendary: Was so smooth that the chickpeas in the next tin asked to be made into it straight away.

lore.common: Spreads on toast in a sweet sticky layer.
lore.uncommon: Drips off the edge of the toast and onto the shirt.
lore.rare: Jumps off the knife onto the nearest clean shirt like a sticky frog.
lore.epic: Dripped through a sandwich onto a picnic blanket, and the ants had a feast.
lore.legendary: Was boiled so long that it set into one strawberry the size of a car.

lore.common: Has a lid screwed on so tightly that nobody can open it.
lore.uncommon: Gets passed round the whole family until somebody strong opens it.
lore.rare: Remembers what was last kept in it, so the cookies always taste faintly of pickles.
lore.epic: Defeated the whole family one evening, until the smallest child opened it first try.
lore.legendary: Kept the smell of one summer's day sealed inside, and opening it in winter makes everyone reach for sunglasses.

lore.common: Is a creamy chocolate hazelnut spread that ends up on every face.
lore.uncommon: Gets eaten straight from the jar with a spoon when nobody is looking.
lore.rare: Hides behind the jam whenever a grown-up opens the cupboard, and comes out again for a child.
lore.epic: Left a chocolate moustache on the whole family at breakfast on school photo day.
lore.legendary: Was spread so smoothly that the hazelnut tree in the garden started growing jars instead of nuts.

lore.common: Spreads thick on bread and sticks to the roof of the mouth.
lore.uncommon: Sticks to the knife so firmly that it needs to be licked off.
lore.rare: Turns crunchy or smooth depending on what its eater did not want.
lore.epic: Glued a jigsaw puzzle together so firmly that the family hung it on the wall as a picture.
lore.legendary: Stuck the clapper of the school bell so firmly that it now rings only on Saturdays.

lore.common: Floats its pickles to the top whenever a fork goes in, and sinks them the moment it is gone.
lore.uncommon: Splashes vinegar on whoever finally opens it.
lore.rare: Turns anything dropped into it into a pickle, so the lost earring is now a very sour gherkin.
lore.epic: Was opened on a bumpy bus, and a pickle shot out and landed in the driver's top pocket.
lore.legendary: Puckered the whole town with one sniff, and every face stayed squeezed until teatime.

lore.common: Is a bowl of chopped tomatoes, onions and a little bit of chilli.
lore.uncommon: Drips red juice down every tortilla chip and onto the tablecloth.
lore.rare: Sneaks a chunk of chilli onto the one chip that the bravest person didn't check.
lore.epic: Was so spicy at a party that the ice in everyone's drinks melted at once.
lore.legendary: Was so spicy that the tortilla chips started wearing oven gloves to dip into it.

lore.common: Holds a spice that nobody has used since they bought it.
lore.uncommon: Has a label so faded that the cook sniffs it every time to guess what's inside.
lore.rare: Swaps labels with the jar next to it whenever the cupboard door is shut.
lore.epic: Was mistaken for cinnamon, and a whole birthday cake tasted of curry.
lore.legendary: Seasoned one stew so well that the pot asked to be washed less often so it could keep the taste.

lore.common: Sits in the fridge door with its spout half open.
lore.uncommon: Gets put back in the fridge with one sip left, so whoever finds it is cross.
lore.rare: Goes sour exactly one day before the date on its side, every single time.
lore.epic: Was opened from the wrong side, and the milk shot across the table straight into the cat's open mouth.
lore.legendary: Stayed fresh so long that its date changed to 'never', and the fridge started treating it with respect.

lore.common: Steams in its mug with marshmallows floating on top.
lore.uncommon: Grows a wrinkly skin on top if it is left for a minute, which half the family loves.
lore.rare: Makes marshmallows float up out of the mug and bob round the room like little balloons.
lore.epic: Was whipped so frothy after a snowball fight that the froth climbed out of the mug and sat on Dad's head like a hat.
lore.legendary: Was stirred so fast that it made a chocolate whirlpool, and a whole bag of marshmallows rode round it like a fairground ride.

lore.common: Steams in the mug and is offered to every visitor before they sit down.
lore.uncommon: Gets brewed with the teabag left in so long that it turns the colour of a brick.
lore.rare: Heats itself up again whenever anyone in the house gets bad news.
lore.epic: Was brewed so strong in the urn for the street party that the bunting stood straight out like flags.
lore.legendary: Was so comforting that a grumpy bus driver drank a cup and drove everyone round town for free.

lore.common: Is sprinkled on chips, eggs and everything else at the table.
lore.uncommon: Clumps into a solid lump in the shaker every time the kitchen gets steamy.
lore.rare: Makes the sea a little saltier every time it is spilled, and the fish have started complaining.
lore.epic: Was thrown over a shoulder for luck so hard that it landed in the soup in the next room.
lore.legendary: Salted the whole sea in one shake, which is why it tastes like that.

lore.common: Has little holes on top that get blocked when the salt goes damp.
lore.uncommon: Comes off its lid at the wrong moment and dumps all the salt on the chips.
lore.rare: Gives out pepper when salt is asked for, and salt when pepper is, on purpose.
lore.epic: Sneezed out every grain at once when the pepper came near, and the dinner table had a blizzard.
lore.legendary: Shook out a single grain so perfectly that the whole meal tasted better, and the chef retired on the spot.

lore.common: Fill the kitchen with smells from far-away places.
lore.uncommon: Make everyone sneeze when the jar is opened too fast.
lore.rare: Makes any dish taste of the last place its cook went on holiday, even porridge.
lore.epic: Got spilled on the barbecue and sent up a cloud so colourful that the neighbours thought a festival had started.
lore.legendary: Flavoured a single grain of rice so strongly that it fed a whole village, one sniff each.

lore.common: Sprays a fine mist over the house plants every morning.
lore.uncommon: Sprays water straight at whoever is holding it.
lore.rare: Squirts the window that has just been cleaned, so it always needs doing again.
lore.epic: Was used in a garden water fight so fiercely that it made a rainbow over the fence, and the neighbours came out for photos.
lore.legendary: Kept a cactus so happy that it grew a flower the size of an umbrella, and the family took it to the beach.

lore.common: Is a little roll of rice and seaweed with something tasty inside.
lore.uncommon: Falls apart when it's dipped in soy sauce for too long.
lore.rare: Wobbles the fish on top whenever soy sauce comes near, as if it is ticklish.
lore.epic: Went round the sushi conveyor so many times that it was given a name.
lore.legendary: Was rolled so long that it went all the way round the restaurant like a conveyor belt of its own.

lore.common: Keeps soup hot all morning and pours a little cup from its own lid.
lore.uncommon: Has a lid that unscrews into a cup and then refuses to screw back on.
lore.rare: Keeps cold things cold and hot things hot, and gets very confused by ice cream on a hot day.
lore.epic: Was opened on a snowy hilltop picnic, and the steam fogged everyone's goggles.
lore.legendary: Kept its tea hot through a whole polar winter, and the explorers used it to warm their toes.

lore.common: Holds flowers on the windowsill and leaves a ring of water on the wood.
lore.uncommon: Tips over whenever the window is opened on a windy day.
lore.rare: Grows back any flower in it the moment it wilts, so the same daisy has lived on the windowsill for years.
lore.epic: Was knocked by a football in the lounge and wobbled for ten seconds before deciding to stay up.
lore.legendary: Was knocked off the shelf by a football and floated gently back up, landing exactly where it was with the flowers still in.

lore.common: Is tall and dark green with a long neck and a label that peels in the damp.
lore.uncommon: Clinks loudly in the recycling bag all the way to the bottle bank.
lore.rare: Rolls off the table so slowly that everyone has time to watch and nobody catches it.
lore.epic: Crashed into the bottle bank so tunefully that a busker asked to borrow it.
lore.legendary: Was turned into a ship in a bottle so detailed that the tiny sailors started sending messages out.

lore.common: Psssts when it's pressed and is kept on a high shelf away from small hands.
lore.uncommon: Sputters out its last puff in a sad little cough and then pretends it is still full.
lore.rare: Hisses back at anyone who shakes it too hard, like a grumpy cat.
lore.epic: Was pressed by mistake in a tiny cupboard and made the coats smell of lemons for a whole winter.
lore.legendary: Sputtered its last puff so dramatically that the family gave it a farewell speech, and then it sprayed once more.

lore.common: Puffs out a smell of pine trees whenever somebody walks past.
lore.uncommon: Runs out of smell the day before visitors arrive, every time.
lore.rare: Makes the house smell of whatever the dog would like, which is mostly sausages.
lore.epic: Puffed so much pine smell that a squirrel came in through the window looking for the trees.
lore.legendary: Made the house smell so much like a forest that a hedgehog moved in for the winter and asked for leaves.

lore.common: Is a teardrop-shaped nut with a crunchy bite.
lore.uncommon: Gets stuck between teeth after every handful.
lore.rare: Plants itself in any pocket it is left in, so coats sprout tiny almond trees by spring.
lore.epic: Was the last nut in the trail mix, and the family hiked an extra mile arguing about who should get it.
lore.legendary: Was cracked so cleanly that its shell became a boat, and a ladybird sailed it across the pond.

lore.common: Sizzles in the pan and spits a little hot fat at the cook.
lore.uncommon: Gets pinched straight off the plate by whoever walks past the kitchen.
lore.rare: Sets off the smoke alarm without any smoke at all, just because it is excited.
lore.epic: Sizzled so loudly on Saturday morning that the radio turned itself down to listen.
lore.legendary: Fried so crispy that it was used as a ladder to rescue the cat from the shed roof.

lore.common: Is fizzy ginger beer in a tall glass, so gingery that it makes noses twitch.
lore.uncommon: Spills its foam over the side when it's poured too fast.
lore.rare: Grows its foam back every time someone blows it off, so the glass never gets any fuller.
lore.epic: Foamed over at the summer fair so much that the cake stall next to it got a fizzy ginger topping.
lore.legendary: Grew a head of foam so tall that it drifted off like a cloud and rained ginger beer on the cricket match.

lore.common: Lives under the sink with a child-proof cap and a strong smell.
lore.uncommon: Has a cap that clicks so loudly that everyone knows the bathroom is being cleaned.
lore.rare: Smells so strong that the bathroom spiders pack their bags the moment its cap clicks.
lore.epic: Was used by the grown-ups on spring-cleaning day, and the bathroom shone so brightly that the family needed sunglasses to brush their teeth.
lore.legendary: Left the bathroom so spotless that the mould wrote a letter of complaint and moved to the neighbour's shed.

lore.common: Squeezes out a blob of gel that smells of fruit or flowers.
lore.uncommon: Squeezes out far too much when the bottle is nearly empty.
lore.rare: Changes its smell every time it is squeezed: coconut, then pine, then fish fingers.
lore.epic: Was squeezed too hard, and the whole shower turned into a bubble bath.
lore.legendary: Made one bubble so strong that the whole family stood inside it and floated to the shops.

lore.common: Twists off a bottle and rolls under the sofa straight away.
lore.uncommon: Pings off the counter when twisted too hard and lands in the dog's water bowl.
lore.rare: Screws itself back onto the wrong bottle, so the juice ends up wearing the milk's lid.
lore.epic: Rolled under the fridge, and the hunt turned up the cap plus two lost spoons, a sock and a very old pea.
lore.legendary: Rolled away so far that it did a full lap of the town and finished back on its own bottle.

lore.common: Has chewy pearls at the bottom that shoot up the big straw.
lore.uncommon: Has its pearls get stuck in the straw on the last sip.
lore.rare: Fires its pearls at whoever forgot to say thank you to the server.
lore.epic: Was slurped so hard in the cinema that the straw whistled and the film paused to see who it was.
lore.legendary: Had so many pearls that a jeweller tried to buy it and was very disappointed by how chewy they were.

lore.common: Flickers in its glass jar and fills the room with a cosy smell.
lore.uncommon: Tunnels down the middle and leaves wax round the edges.
lore.rare: Keeps glowing for a minute after it is blown out, just to have the last word.
lore.epic: Made the lounge so cosy one evening that the cat, the dog and Grandad all fell asleep in one heap.
lore.legendary: Smelled so strongly of cookies that the whole street knocked at the door, and there were no cookies at all.

lore.common: Is curved like a little moon and is always picked first from the mixed nuts.
lore.uncommon: Disappears from the bowl so fast that only peanuts are left.
lore.rare: Turns every peanut it touches into a cashew, so the bowl slowly changes while nobody watches.
lore.epic: Was hidden in Grandad's sleeve at a party so often that his jumper became a nut bowl.
lore.legendary: Curled itself into a crescent so perfect that it was hung in the night sky over the village.

lore.common: Is shiny and brown and comes out of a spiky green shell.
lore.uncommon: Pops in the fire if nobody remembers to cut a cross in it.
lore.rare: Pops out of the fire straight into the pocket of whoever is coldest.
lore.epic: Rolled out of the roasting pan and across the frozen pond, and the ducks played ice hockey with it.
lore.legendary: Grew into a chestnut tree so tall that the winter market now sets up in its branches, stalls and all.

lore.common: Is covered in sticky sauce that ends up on every finger.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a pile of bones on the plate that grows all evening.
lore.rare: Glows red when it is too spicy, like a little warning light.
lore.epic: Was eaten so messily at a game night that the dice stuck together and only ever rolled double six.
lore.legendary: Was so spicy that its eater's ears steamed like a kettle, and Gran made a cup of tea with them.

lore.common: Are little round beans that roll across the counter when spilled.
lore.uncommon: Roll off the plate and under the table at every meal.
lore.rare: Swells to twice its size in water and pushes the lid off any jar it is kept in.
lore.epic: Rolled down the stairs one by one and played a tune on every step.
lore.legendary: Was planted in a flowerpot by accident and grew a plant that makes hummus by itself.

lore.common: Sprays a fresh-smelling mist and lives up high where only grown-ups can reach.
lore.uncommon: Sprays sideways when the nozzle isn't turned the right way.
lore.rare: Makes the counter so clean that the dog slips on it.
lore.epic: Was used by the grown-ups before a party, and the counter got so slippery that the cake slid all the way to the guests.
lore.legendary: Wiped down the kitchen so thoroughly that the old oven came out looking brand new and asked to have its photo taken.

lore.common: Is a brown powder that turns milk into hot chocolate.
lore.uncommon: Puffs up a little cloud whenever its tin is opened.
lore.rare: Turns any milk in the fridge slightly chocolatey overnight, just by being in the cupboard.
lore.epic: Was spooned so fast that a brown cloud floated out of the window and dusted the washing on the line.
lore.legendary: Puffed one cloud so big that it hung over the town all day, and everyone came home smelling of biscuits.

lore.common: Has a little valve that puffs out coffee smell when it's squeezed.
lore.uncommon: Spills grounds on the counter every time it's opened.
lore.rare: Spills a neat trail of grounds from the cupboard to whoever opened it last.
lore.epic: Was spilled on the floor, and the kitchen smelled like a cafe for a week.
lore.legendary: Smelled so good that the sleepiest owl in town stayed awake all day and became a morning bird.

lore.common: Are shiny brown beans that smell like a cafe.
lore.uncommon: Rattle in the grinder like hailstones, and the cat hides under the table every morning.
lore.rare: Roll themselves into a heart shape on the counter whenever someone says they need a coffee.
lore.epic: Were spilled across the office kitchen, and everyone stepped on them for a week.
lore.legendary: Woke a hibernating bear in the middle of winter, and it went to work at the office instead.

lore.common: Makes hair smooth and soft, if it's rinsed out properly.
lore.uncommon: Gets forgotten in the shower, so the hair goes frizzy.
lore.rare: Makes hair so slippery that a hairband slides right off.
lore.epic: Made hair so slippery that the whole family's hair clips slid off and pinged round the bathroom like popcorn.
lore.legendary: Untangled the knots in a whole fishing net in one wash, and the fishermen named their boat after it.

lore.common: Plugs up a bottle and pops out with a satisfying sound.
lore.uncommon: Breaks in half when it's pulled out, leaving the rest stuck in the bottle.
lore.rare: Floats back up to the top of any bottle it is pushed into, however hard anyone tries.
lore.epic: Popped out at a party so hard that it hit the ceiling and bounced into a cake.
lore.legendary: Floated across the ocean with a message tied to it and came back with a reply.

lore.common: Glugs into the washing machine and makes the laundry smell fresh.
lore.uncommon: Drips down its side so the bottle is always sticky.
lore.rare: Turns every white sock pink, even when there is no red sock in the wash.
lore.epic: Was poured too much, and the washing machine foamed all over the kitchen floor.
lore.legendary: Washed the football team's kit so white that the match stopped because the referee was dazzled.

lore.common: Squeezes into the washing up bowl and makes a mountain of bubbles.
lore.uncommon: Stands on the windowsill with a crust of dried bubbles round its lid.
lore.rare: Makes any plate it touches so slippery that it slides out of the rack and back into the sink.
lore.epic: Made so many bubbles that the washing-up became a bubble castle, with the teaspoons standing guard.
lore.legendary: Lasted through a whole year of birthday parties and still had bubbles left over for the bath.

lore.common: Has a handy bone handle and a crispy coating.
lore.uncommon: Leaves its eater with greasy fingers and a big smile.
lore.rare: Plays a drumroll on the plate whenever someone reaches for it.
lore.epic: Was dropped at a picnic, bounced once on the blanket and was caught by the dog in mid-air.
lore.legendary: Was so tasty at the family picnic that the ants built a little statue of it out of crumbs.

lore.common: Is a tiny brown bottle with a dropper that lets out one drop at a time.
lore.uncommon: Lets out three drops when only one was wanted.
lore.rare: Makes anyone who sniffs it yawn twice and forget what they came into the room for.
lore.epic: Was spilled by accident, and the whole house smelled like lavender for a month.
lore.legendary: Calmed the house so much that the dog, the cat and the goldfish all lay down for a nap at the same time.

lore.common: Comes wrapped in paper with chips and a fish in crispy batter.
lore.uncommon: Gets so much vinegar shaken on it that the paper wrapping goes see-through.
lore.rare: Smudges the newspaper it is wrapped in until the headlines are all about chips.
lore.epic: Was carried along the seafront so proudly that the lighthouse turned its beam to follow it.
lore.legendary: Was battered so big that the fish became a boat, and the family rowed it home using two chips as oars.

names.legendary: Flakerton, the Fish of Many Fish

lore.common: Is a flat piece of fish that flakes when it's touched with a fork.
lore.uncommon: Breaks apart in the pan when it's turned.
lore.rare: Swims round the plate when the lemon is squeezed on it, as if it can hear the sea.
lore.epic: Was cooked for the family dinner, and the cat sang outside the window until it got the skin.
lore.legendary: Flaked so perfectly that every flake turned into a tiny fish and swam back to the sea.

lore.common: Gets measured out with a mug because the scales are always somewhere else.
lore.uncommon: Leaves white handprints on everything in the kitchen.
lore.rare: Rises like dough when spilled, so a small spill becomes a small white hill.
lore.epic: Was dropped on baking day, and everyone looked like ghosts.
lore.legendary: Was sifted so fine that it hung over the town like a morning mist, and the bus drove through it and came out white.

lore.common: Has a crunchy coat that flakes off with every bite.
lore.uncommon: Always has one piece that is mostly coating with nothing inside.
lore.rare: Gets crispier the longer it waits, so the last piece could be used as a hammer.
lore.epic: Was shared out of a bucket so fast that the empty bucket was worn as a hat for the rest of the party.
lore.legendary: Crunched so loudly at a family dinner that a passing earthquake thought it had been beaten and went home.

lore.common: Sits in the shed with a long spout and a strong smell, well away from anything hot.
lore.uncommon: Is always nearly empty when the lawnmower needs filling.
lore.rare: Has a spout so long that it's hard to aim straight.
lore.epic: Was carried out by a grown-up on mowing day, and the lawnmower got so excited that it cut a smiley face into the lawn.
lore.legendary: Kept the village mower going so long that it mowed the green into a maze, and the sheep still haven't found the way out.

lore.common: Stands outside by the barbecue, heavy and painted bright orange.
lore.uncommon: Runs out just as the sausages are halfway cooked.
lore.rare: Hisses a little sigh whenever the barbecue is lit, as if it has seen too many burnt sausages.
lore.epic: Ran out at the barbecue, so the party finished the burgers in the toaster.
lore.legendary: Kept a barbecue lit through a whole rainy summer, and the clouds got so hungry that they stopped raining to queue.

names.legendary: The Spray That Made Windows Vanish

lore.common: Sprays blue liquid on windows and squeaks when it's wiped off.
lore.uncommon: Leaves streaks on the window that only show in the sunshine.
lore.rare: Squeaks a little tune when it is wiped, and the tune is different for every window.
lore.epic: Cleaned a window so well that the cat sat staring at its reflection all afternoon, waiting for the other cat to move.
lore.legendary: Made the windows so clean that the family thought they had been taken out.

names.legendary: The Soap That Washed a Million Hands

lore.common: Pumps out foam that smells of flowers when it's pressed.
lore.uncommon: Squirts across the sink when it's pumped too hard.
lore.rare: Gives a little round of foam applause whenever someone washes for the full twenty seconds.
lore.epic: Was pumped so hard by a toddler that it foamed up a cloud big enough to hide the toddler.
lore.legendary: Has washed so many hands that it now sings a little song with every pump.

names.legendary: The Nut That Fooled a Squirrel

lore.common: Is small and round and hides inside a hard brown shell.
lore.uncommon: Gets buried in the garden by a squirrel that forgets where it put it.
lore.rare: Rolls away from the nutcracker on purpose and hides behind the biscuit tin.
lore.epic: Was buried by a squirrel and grew into a tree the next spring.
lore.legendary: Fooled a squirrel into burying it three times in three different gardens.

lore.common: Comes in a tiny bottle with a warning on the label.
lore.uncommon: Comes out in a big splash when only one drop was wanted.
lore.rare: Warms up any dish it is near, so the ice cream next to it melts on its own.
lore.epic: Was spilled on the barbecue, and the flames went so red that the fire engine drove past twice to check.
lore.legendary: Was so hot that one drop on the beach turned the sand beneath it into glass.

lore.common: Holds dark blue ink and a little glass well for dipping a pen.
lore.uncommon: Leaves blue fingers on whoever opens it.
lore.rare: Makes any word written with it impossible to spell wrong, which annoys the spelling test.
lore.epic: Was spilled in a calligraphy class, and the blots spelled out a perfect alphabet.
lore.legendary: Wrote a letter so long that the postman needed a wheelbarrow, and the reply came back just as long.

lore.common: Is a square can with a handle that sits in the back of the car for emergencies.
lore.uncommon: Clunks around in the boot on every bumpy road.
lore.rare: Makes a car smell so strongly of fuel that the windows stay open the whole drive.
lore.epic: Clunked about in the boot so loudly on a bumpy road trip that the family thought a goat had got in.
lore.legendary: Clunked so steadily on a long drive that a band in the next car recorded it, and the song reached the radio.

lore.common: Pours bright orange into a glass and has bits that some people don't like.
lore.uncommon: Splashes on the table when it's poured too fast.
lore.rare: Turns its drinker's tongue bright orange for an hour, so everyone knows who finished it.
lore.epic: Was spilled at breakfast, and the cat got an orange stripe.
lore.legendary: Was squeezed so fresh that the orange tree outside grew a new orange to replace it before breakfast was over.

lore.common: Has chunks of meat and vegetables stacked on a long stick.
lore.uncommon: Spins on the grill so the same side always gets burnt.
lore.rare: Slides its chunks off the stick one by one onto other people's plates.
lore.epic: Was waved so wildly by a hungry uncle that the onion flew over the fence into next door's paddling pool.
lore.legendary: Was so long that its two ends were cooked on different barbecues in different gardens.

lore.common: Is bright red and gets on every chip, every chin and somehow the ceiling.
lore.uncommon: Refuses to come out until someone slaps the bottom of the bottle.
lore.rare: Turns any food it touches red, even the peas, which look very embarrassed.
lore.epic: Splattered all over the table at chip night, and everyone laughed.
lore.legendary: Was slapped out of the bottle so hard that it flew across the cafe and landed perfectly on a hot dog at the far table.

lore.common: Stands upside down in the fridge door so the sauce is ready to go.
lore.uncommon: Grows a dry red crust on its nozzle that nobody ever wipes off.
lore.rare: Makes a rude noise when it's nearly empty, at the quietest moment of every meal.
lore.epic: Was squeezed so hard at a barbecue that it painted a red stripe across three burgers and an uncle.
lore.legendary: Squeezed out its very last drop without a single sputter, and the table gave it a standing ovation.

lore.common: Sits in a tin in the cupboard, waiting for a big pot of chilli.
lore.uncommon: Gets spilled when the tin is drained and rolls round the sink.
lore.rare: Rolls under the cooker in a little red army whenever the tin is opened.
lore.epic: Made a chilli so warming at the bonfire party that the guests stood round the pot instead of the fire.
lore.legendary: Made a chilli so famous that the pot itself now signs autographs.

lore.common: Is cold, fizzy and so sour that it makes faces pucker.
lore.uncommon: Gets so many lemon pips in it that every sip needs checking.
lore.rare: Tastes sweeter for whoever made it and sourer for everyone else.
lore.epic: Was sold from a garden stall so sour that the customers' faces stayed puckered until the ice-cream van came.
lore.legendary: Squeezed every lemon in the orchard into one jug, and the lemon trees have been sulking ever since.

lore.common: Are tiny orange discs that pour like sand into the pan.
lore.uncommon: Spill across the counter and hide in every corner.
lore.rare: Doubles in size when cooked and quietly lifts the saucepan lid to escape.
lore.epic: Were poured into the pan so fast that they sounded like a rainstorm, and the family ran to bring the washing in.
lore.legendary: Made one bowl of soup so warming that the house did not need its heating for a month.

lore.common: Pours slowly over pancakes in a golden river.
lore.uncommon: Sticks the bottle's lid shut every single time.
lore.rare: Pours so slowly that the pancakes are cold by the time it reaches them.
lore.epic: Flooded a whole stack of pancakes, and the plate became a sticky pond.
lore.legendary: Was tapped from a tree so old and so sweet that the woodpeckers now queue at it with tiny cups.

lore.common: Spreads on sandwiches in a creamy white layer.
lore.uncommon: Squelches out of the sides of the sandwich when it's bitten.
lore.rare: Turns any salad it touches into a creamy one, even the fruit salad.
lore.epic: Was squeezed so hard at a picnic that it drew a white line down the blanket, and the two families stayed on their own sides.
lore.legendary: Spread so evenly that the groundsman used it to paint the white lines on the football pitch.

lore.common: Sits on top of spaghetti in a pool of tomato sauce.
lore.uncommon: Rolls off the fork every time it's speared.
lore.rare: Steers the spaghetti like reins, so it can drive the whole plate across the table.
lore.epic: Was sneezed off the plate at spaghetti night and rolled into the garden, where it grew into a meatball bush.
lore.legendary: Rolled down the hill so far that it gathered every lost pea in town and came back the size of a car.

names.legendary: Lockwell, Keeper of the Top Shelf

lore.common: Waits on the top shelf with a little plastic cup on its head like a hat.
lore.uncommon: Drips a sticky line down the side every time it's poured.
lore.rare: Has a measuring cap so small that pouring the right amount takes great care.
lore.epic: Was kept on a shelf so high that the grown-ups needed the stepladder, and the stepladder now lives in the bathroom.
lore.legendary: Was locked away so safely that even the family's very clever cat gave up after a week of trying.

lore.common: Is so thick that it takes all the puff in the world to sip through a straw.
lore.uncommon: Gets slurped so loudly at the bottom of the glass that the whole cafe turns round.
lore.rare: Is so cold that it freezes the straw solid, so the straw can be eaten as a lolly afterwards.
lore.epic: Was slurped so hard at a diner that the jukebox skipped and played the same song all afternoon.
lore.legendary: Was blended so cold that it started a snowstorm in the diner, and the waitress served the burgers on sledges.

lore.common: Is a tall glass with a swirl of cream and a cherry balanced on top.
lore.uncommon: Has its cherry fall off the cream the moment it's set down.
lore.rare: Makes the cherry on top hop over to whoever looks saddest at the table.
lore.epic: Was piled so high with cream that it needed scaffolding, and a builder in a hard hat carried it to the table.
lore.legendary: Was so tall that the cherry on top was picked by a passing hot-air balloon.

lore.common: Has a shiny blue-black shell that opens when it's cooked.
lore.uncommon: Stays shut in the pot when all the others have opened.
lore.rare: Clamps onto any spoon that comes near, so the soup spoons come out wearing mussels like hats.
lore.epic: Was steamed in a big pot at the seaside, and every shell popped open at once.
lore.legendary: Opened its shell so wide that it laughed, and the whole pot caught the giggles.

lore.common: Squeezes out in a bright yellow line on top of a hotdog.
lore.uncommon: Squirts too much, so the hotdog is more mustard than sausage.
lore.rare: Writes its own name in yellow on every hot dog it is squeezed onto.
lore.epic: Squirted a stripe so straight down the picnic table that the ants used it as a running track.
lore.legendary: Was so hot that the sausage in the bun sat up and said 'ooh'.

lore.common: Is a square of dried noodles with a little flavour packet inside.
lore.uncommon: Gets its flavour packet lost under the sofa.
lore.rare: Crumbles into a thousand pieces in the bag the moment someone wants it whole.
lore.epic: Was snapped in half so hard that one half flew across the student kitchen into the kettle, which made dinner anyway.
lore.legendary: Cooked itself in three minutes flat on a mountain top using only sunshine, and the climbers had hot dinner at the summit.

lore.common: Is golden and crispy and shaped like a little cloud.
lore.uncommon: Gets dipped in ketchup so many times that it turns red.
lore.rare: Changes shape every time it is turned over: a star, a cloud, then a slightly worried face.
lore.epic: Was hidden in a lunchbox, and by break time the whole class had smelled it and asked to swap.
lore.legendary: Was shaped so exactly like a dinosaur that it stomped off the plate and roared at the ketchup.

lore.common: Glugs out cooking oil and leaves a slippery ring on the shelf.
lore.uncommon: Drips down its own side so that it's always slippery to hold.
lore.rare: Slips out of the hand so easily that it needs two hands to pour.
lore.epic: Slipped out of a hand and made the kitchen floor an ice rink.
lore.legendary: Was poured into the town clock so smoothly that it ran backwards, and the whole town got an extra hour in bed.

lore.common: Drizzles over salad in a golden green stream.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a greasy thumbprint on every page of the recipe book.
lore.rare: Makes salad leaves stand up and shine as if they are in an advert.
lore.epic: Was poured so generously on a salad that the lettuce leaves sailed round the bowl like little boats.
lore.legendary: Came from an olive tree so old that it remembers the dinosaurs, and it still says the salads were better then.

names.legendary: Pearlington, Keeper of the Giant Pearl

lore.common: Has a rough grey shell that hides something shiny inside.
lore.uncommon: Is so hard to open that it needs a special knife and a grown-up.
lore.rare: Whispers the sound of the sea to anyone who holds it to their ear, then spits water in it.
lore.epic: Snapped shut on the waiter's tie at a fancy dinner, so he served pudding with an oyster on his chest.
lore.legendary: Grew a pearl so big that it could not close its shell, so it uses the pearl as a pillow.

lore.common: Rattles when it's shaken and is used outside with the windows open.
lore.uncommon: Leaves its user with one colourful finger after every use.
lore.rare: Changes colour to match its user's mood, so grumpy days come out grey.
lore.epic: Sprayed a model plane so well that the plane took off and looped round the garden.
lore.legendary: Painted an old rusty bike so beautifully that it rode off on its own to show its friends.

names.legendary: Threender, the Box With Three Ends

lore.common: Rattles when it's picked up and spills a few pieces on the counter.
lore.uncommon: Gets opened from the wrong end so that pasta falls everywhere.
lore.rare: Turns spaghetti into penne inside the box when nobody is looking, so every recipe needs changing.
lore.epic: Spilled across the kitchen, and the family played pasta hockey with brooms.
lore.legendary: Was opened at the wrong end so many times that it grew a third end.

lore.common: Hides two nuts inside a crinkly shell.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a pile of shells wherever it's eaten.
lore.rare: Hides an extra nut in its shell for whoever is kindest, and an empty shell for whoever grabs first.
lore.epic: Left so many shells at a football match that the pitch crunched and the ball bounced the wrong way.
lore.legendary: Was cracked open and had a whole tiny peanut farm inside, tractor and all.

lore.common: Splits out of its shell in two halves that never quite fit back together.
lore.uncommon: Gets stuck between teeth whenever it's eaten in pie.
lore.rare: Arranges itself in perfect rings on top of every pie, even when it was just thrown on.
lore.epic: Topped a pie so thickly that it had to be cut with a saw at the family dinner.
lore.legendary: Grew on a tree so tall that the squirrels need a lift to reach the top.

lore.common: Has a green nut inside a shell that smiles open.
lore.uncommon: Has one shell that's closed tight and won't open at all.
lore.rare: Smiles a little wider whenever someone compliments it, and snaps shut when ignored.
lore.epic: Snapped shut on Grandad's finger at a party and would not let go until he told a joke.
lore.legendary: Was the only pistachio in the world that opened itself, so the rest of the bowl made it their leader.

lore.common: Sits on the camping stove, white and squat, and hisses a polite hello when a grown-up opens the valve.
lore.uncommon: Rattles in the car boot all the way to the campsite like a grumpy drum.
lore.rare: Frosts over when it is working hard, so it is the only thing at the campsite wearing a coat of ice.
lore.epic: Cooked so many breakfasts on a camping trip that the bears left a thank-you note.
lore.legendary: Kept a camping trip going so long that the family forgot their house, and the post is now delivered to the tent.

lore.common: Are scooped out of a pumpkin and roasted until they're crunchy.
lore.uncommon: Stick to everything when they're scooped out.
lore.rare: Pops in the oven like popcorn, and every pop sounds like a tiny ghost saying 'boo'.
lore.epic: Were roasted at a pumpkin carving night and spilled into the lantern, which grinned even wider.
lore.legendary: Were planted in the school field and grew a pumpkin so big that the school held assembly inside it.

lore.common: Pours from its bag like a soft rain.
lore.uncommon: Spills across the counter and gets stuck in every crack.
lore.rare: Grows in the pan so much that the pan overflows.
lore.epic: Spilled into the vacuum cleaner and rattled inside it like a rain stick for a week.
lore.legendary: Counted itself one night and found exactly one grain for every person in the world, plus one for the cat.

lore.common: Splurts out sauce whenever it's shaken just slightly too hard.
lore.uncommon: Has a dried brown crust round its lid that cracks like a biscuit when it opens.
lore.rare: Splurts only at whoever said they didn't want any sauce, from across the table.
lore.epic: Splurted so hard at the chip shop that the fish on the menu board got a brown moustache.
lore.legendary: Has sat on the same cafe table for so long that it has its own chair and a cup of tea.

lore.common: Is a tiny seed that's sprinkled on top of burger buns.
lore.uncommon: Falls off the bun and onto the plate with every bite.
lore.rare: Hides between two teeth and pops out exactly in the middle of the school photo.
lore.epic: Was sprinkled so thickly on a bun that the bun turned into a little hedgehog.
lore.legendary: Said 'open' to a cave door once, and the door opened, so now it is kept in the kitchen for stuck jars.

lore.common: Stands on the edge of the bath and falls in every time the plug is pulled.
lore.uncommon: Stings eyes whenever its foam drips down a face.
lore.rare: Gives its user a different hairstyle every wash, whether they want one or not.
lore.epic: Made so much lather in the bath that a child gave themselves a bubble beard.
lore.legendary: Washed a lion's mane at the zoo so well that it now poses for shampoo adverts.

lore.common: Has a little pile of pink prawns with their tails sticking up.
lore.uncommon: Leaves its tails in a neat pink fan round the edge of every plate.
lore.rare: Curls up so tightly when cooked that it looks like it is doing a little sit-up.
lore.epic: Curled up so tightly at a party that the prawns rolled off the plate like little wheels.
lore.legendary: Curled its prawns in perfect time, and they performed a synchronised swimming show in the sauce.

lore.common: Is thick and fruity and comes in every colour of the rainbow.
lore.uncommon: Separates into stripes if it is left for a minute, like a fruity flag.
lore.rare: Turns its drinker the colour of its fruit for an hour, so the whole family went green after the spinach one.
lore.epic: Was carried to school in a flask that burst on the bus, and the whole top deck smelled of mango.
lore.legendary: Blended a whole orchard into one glass, and the trees outside now stand a little nervously.

lore.common: Is dark and salty and comes in a little bottle with a red lid.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a small brown ring on the table every time it is put down.
lore.rare: Drips out of its bottle only after the sushi has been eaten.
lore.epic: Was used on every dish at a family dinner, including the pudding.
lore.legendary: Seasoned one bowl of rice so perfectly that the rice bowl asked to marry it.

lore.common: Hides inside a fuzzy green pod and pops out when squeezed.
lore.uncommon: Pops out of its pod and across the table at the wrong moment.
lore.rare: Fires itself out of its pod straight into whoever's mouth is open.
lore.epic: Was popped out of a whole bowl of pods so fast that it rained soybeans on the next table.
lore.legendary: Became tofu, milk, sauce and a snack, and still wanted to do more.

lore.common: Lives on the shed shelf next to the oil can, and the two argue about who squeaks less.
lore.uncommon: Rattles when it's shaken, so everyone knows it's about to be used.
lore.rare: Unsqueaks anything it is sprayed near, including the floorboards, the gate and Grandad's knees.
lore.epic: Was sprayed to fix a squeaky gate, and the whole street stopped hearing the squeak.
lore.legendary: Oiled the creakiest door in the village so well that the ghost who lived behind it had nothing to do and left.

lore.common: Sizzles on the grill and gets its stripes from the hot bars.
lore.uncommon: Shrinks in the pan to half its size.
lore.rare: Sizzles in a code only the dog understands, so the dog is always first into the kitchen.
lore.epic: Was so big at Sunday dinner that it was carried in by two people and a skateboard.
lore.legendary: Cooked rare, medium and well done all at once, so everyone at the table got the end they wanted.

lore.common: Pours out in a white stream that sparkles in the light.
lore.uncommon: Spills on the table and makes everything sticky.
lore.rare: Makes every wasp in the room fall in love with whoever is holding it.
lore.epic: Spilled so thickly on the kitchen floor that the robot vacuum got a sugar rush and cleaned the garden too.
lore.legendary: Sweetened the school dinners so much for one day that the cabbage was the first thing to run out.

lore.common: Have stripy shells that crack open with a little click.
lore.uncommon: Leave a pile of shells on every park bench.
lore.rare: Turns its eater's head to follow the sun all afternoon, like a sunflower.
lore.epic: Were dropped in the playground and grew a sunflower so tall that the slide now ends in its petals.
lore.legendary: Fed a flock of birds so well that they carried the family's picnic blanket to the beach for them.

lore.common: Squeezes out golden syrup over pancakes in a long ribbon.
lore.uncommon: Lets out a slow golden drip that lands exactly where somebody's elbow will go.
lore.rare: Glues the pancake to the plate, so the plate comes too whenever the pancake is lifted.
lore.epic: Was squeezed so hard on pancake day that a golden ribbon shot across the kitchen and tied the cupboard doors shut.
lore.legendary: Poured so slowly that one drip took a whole week, and the family threw a party when it landed.

names.legendary: The Vinegar That Cleaned the Windows

lore.common: Is so sour that its smell makes noses wrinkle.
lore.uncommon: Splashes on chips so much that they go soggy.
lore.rare: Turns any chip soggy from three tables away, just by being shaken in its direction.
lore.epic: Was shaken on chips at the seaside, and the seagulls stayed away.
lore.legendary: Was used on chips, salad and the windows, and did all three perfectly.

lore.common: Has a little shaker top that drips vinegar onto chips.
lore.uncommon: Has a shaker top with one hole that fires sideways, always at the customer.
lore.rare: Refills itself overnight, so it has been exactly half full since the chip shop opened.
lore.epic: Was shaken so hard at the seaside shop that the spray drifted out to sea and pickled a passing fishing boat.
lore.legendary: Shook out one drop so sharp that it woke a sleeping lighthouse, and the lighthouse winks at it every night.

lore.common: Sits beside the kettle so the grown-ups see it every morning and remember.
lore.uncommon: Is always the last thing packed for holidays and the first thing forgotten.
lore.rare: Rattles out a little tune each morning, getting louder until a grown-up picks it up.
lore.epic: Rattled so loudly on the bathroom shelf in a storm that the family thought the thunder had come indoors.
lore.legendary: Rattled so loudly every morning that the cockerel next door gave up crowing and went back to bed.

lore.common: Looks like a little brain inside its hard wrinkly shell.
lore.uncommon: Crumbles into dust when it's cracked too hard.
lore.rare: Rolls out of the fruit bowl at night and is always found under the radiator.
lore.epic: Was cracked by the fire with such a bang that the cat leapt onto the curtains and stayed there until supper.
lore.legendary: Looked so much like a brain that it started doing the family's homework, and getting it right.

lore.common: Stands on the table with a long neck, and someone always tries to play it like a flute.
lore.uncommon: Always gets passed to the wrong end of the table, then all the way back again.
lore.rare: Catches the candlelight so well that the whole table glows green at dinner.
lore.epic: Was set down so hard at a birthday dinner that every glass on the table rang like a bell.
lore.legendary: Hummed a note so deep when someone blew across its neck that the cows in the next field mooed back in harmony.
